deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.note: Applications open September 1, 2026. Program starts August 23, 2027.

english.toefl: 79 (old scale) or 4 (new 1–6 scale); Home Edition 79; Essentials 8.5
english.note: Also accepts IELTS Indicator/One Skill Retake, PTE Academic/Academic Online 55, CPE/CAE 185. Scores must be within two years of International Admissions review and sent by the testing agency. English exemption requires citizenship AND English-medium education in one of the listed countries, or another listed category. A qualifying transfer from a US college needs a completed degree or at least two years there, GPA2.0 and no more than a three-year break. Recent UB program/degree changes and reciprocal nondegree exchanges have separate criteria. Overseas English-medium study alone is not an automatic exemption. Rare exceptions require a petition from the UB academic department, not the applicant, with justification and supporting records; International Admissions decides.

applicationFee.note: The international-applicant FAQ explicitly says fee waivers are not available.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from every college/university attended
Personal statement (no word limit), highlighting biological coursework and research
Unofficial WES evaluation for all international transcripts
Official English proficiency scores if required
requirements.note: Bachelor's degree or equivalent from an accredited/government-recognized institution and undergraduate GPA of at least 3.0 required. Some three-year degrees are recognized; the page explicitly accepts accredited Indian three-year degrees. Apply to the program, not directly to a laboratory; three research rotations precede mentor selection. Transfer applicants need a letter from a current faculty member familiar with their work and reasons for transfer in the statement.

funding.note: All doctoral students receive a stipend, full tuition scholarship and paid student fees, guaranteed for the duration of training contingent on good academic standing. No stipend amount or health-insurance coverage is stated on this page.

international.note: International applicants are welcome; the program expects approximately 30% of its incoming class to be international. An unofficial WES report is required.
